summary.text: Jeff Litke is the Democratic candidate for the Connecticut House of Representatives, District 70, in the November 3, 2026 general election against incumbent Seth Bronko (R / Independent Party of Connecticut).
He also ran for the seat in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Jeff Litke lost to Bronko in the 2022 general election, 56.3 percent to 43.8 percent in a race with no incumbent, and again in 2024, when Bronko was the incumbent, 55.1 percent to 44.9 percent.
